TwoLevelParallelMediationData Class

Source: R/classes-twolevel.R
TwoLevelParallelMediationData.Rd

Experimental. Like TwoLevelMediationData, this class may change without the usual deprecation period.

Usage

TwoLevelParallelMediationData(
  a_within, b_within, c_prime_within, a_between, b_between, c_prime_between,
  estimates, vcov, parameter_table, treatment, mediators, outcome, cluster, n_obs,
  n_clusters, cluster_sizes, icc, between_identified, admissible, converged,
  cross_level_equal, fixed_paths, source, fixed_x, information, h1_information,
  se_type, estimator, missing, lavaan_version, call, between_parameterization,
  data, source_package, source_version
)

Arguments

a_within, b_within

Named numeric vectors of length k (names mediators): within-level paths \(X \to M_j\) and \(M_j \to Y\) (always finite).

c_prime_within

Numeric scalar: within-level direct path (always finite).

a_between, b_between

Named numeric vectors of length k: between-level paths; all NA_real_ when between_identified is FALSE.

c_prime_between

Numeric scalar: between-level direct path; NA_real_ when between_identified is FALSE.

estimates

Named numeric vector of the identified path rows (the alias rows above).

vcov

Covariance matrix of estimates: the sub-block of the fit's joint covariance, so the cross-level and cross-mediator covariances are carried.

parameter_table

Data frame, one row per path row (path, level, lhs, op, rhs, label, free, est, se), kept for audit.

treatment, outcome, cluster

Character scalars: variable names.

mediators

Character vector of length \(k \ge 2\): unique mediator names, in the order of the path vectors.

n_obs, n_clusters

Integer scalars: rows used and number of clusters.

cluster_sizes

Integer vector of cluster sizes (length n_clusters).

icc

Named numeric vector: intraclass correlation of the treatment, each mediator and the outcome. It is the unrestricted (h1) estimate, as for TwoLevelMediationData; the within-only rule reads it.

between_identified

Logical scalar: whether the between level is identified.

admissible

Logical scalar: lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "post.check").

converged

Logical scalar: whether the fit converged.

cross_level_equal

Character vector: paths equated across levels.

fixed_paths

Character vector: path rows with free == 0 (variance 0 in vcov).

source

Character scalar: "lavaan" or "native".

fixed_x, information, h1_information, se_type, estimator, missing

How the fit was made, read from it.

lavaan_version, call

Character scalars: provenance of the fit.

between_parameterization

Character scalar: "latent" (cluster means are latent).

data

Data frame or NULL: always NULL for the lavaan adapter.

source_package

Character scalar: "lavaan", or "medfit" for a native two-level fit.

source_version

Character: character(0) (the default) or one non-empty string, the version of the package that made the fit.

Value

A TwoLevelParallelMediationData S7 object.

Details

S7 class for two-level mediation with \(k \ge 2\) parallel mediators, all measured on level-1 units nested in clusters (1-1-1), with the paths estimated separately at the within and the between level (latent cluster means, fixed slopes). It is the parallel counterpart of TwoLevelMediationData: a separate class, so the one-mediator object keeps its scalar paths. Every property other than the paths and mediators has the meaning it has there.

Per level \(l\) the specific indirect effect through \(M_j\) is \(a_{jl} b_{jl}\), the total indirect effect is \(\sum_j a_{jl} b_{jl}\) and the direct effect is \(c'_l\). When the between level cannot be identified the object is within-only: the between path vectors hold NA_real_ (still named by mediators), c_prime_between is NA_real_, and the between rows are absent from estimates and vcov.

The alias rows of estimates and vcov are, per level, a_<M>_within for each mediator, then b_<M>_within, then c_prime_within, and the same set with _between.
